_description: Per-hectare economics for the 9 fixed land-use activities of the Mai Chau / Da Bac ABM (2025-2042, annual step). Market values only: PFES, protection contracts and planting support are NOT included here; they live in scenarios.json. Prices 2024-2025 VND.

rural_wage.source: Assumption for hired farm labour in Mai Chau/Da Bac. Anchors: legal floor Region IV (all of former Hoa Binh except HB city and Luong Son) 3,450,000 VND/month = 16,600 VND/h = 132,800 VND per 8-h day (Decree 74/2024/ND-CP, https://xaydungchinhsach.chinhphu.vn/toan-van-nghi-dinh-74-2024-nd-cp-quy-dinh-muc-luong-toi-thieu-vung-119240701122135822.htm, verified); Region IV from 1/1/2026 3,700,000 VND/month, 17,800 VND/h (Decree 293/2025/ND-CP, approximate); hired forestry labour Yen Chau (Son La) 7.65 USD/day ~181,000 VND in 2022 (Kyaw et al. 2024 Forestist 74(3), verified); rural employed-worker income 6.7 M VND/month 2024 (NSO Q4/2024 press release, verified).

annualisation.method: Equal annuity (capital-recovery factor) at 8%/yr: A = PV(flows) * r / (1 - (1+r)^-n), establishment at t=0, all other flows at the end of years 1..n; n = rotation or economic life. Output, variable cost and labour are annualised separately; establishment cost is reported one-off (establishment_cost_vnd_per_ha) and as an annuity (establishment_cost_annualised_vnd_per_ha_yr).
annualisation.rationale: 8% sits between the 6.5-9% used by Phuong et al. 2016 (Da Bac) and the 8.5% used by Tuan 2013 (Luong Son acacia); commercial smallholder credit in VN is ~8-10%/yr. Real-rate LEVs (3%) in Kyaw et al. 2024 would favour long rotations much more.
annualisation.script: not part of the repo; the formula and the CRF values are in docs/research/scenario.md

MAIZE_INT.notes: Maize (or cassava) monocrop on slopes, complete clearance, burning, herbicide; one main crop per year. Gross = 4.5 t/ha x 6,200 VND/kg dry grain (Hoa Binh provincial mean 4.79 t/ha in 2024 includes lowland; remote sloping plots lower; farm-gate 6,000-7,000 VND/kg 2024-25). Cassava alternative: 15.7 t/ha (HB 2024) x 2,000-2,900 VND/kg = 31-45 M gross but price crashed to 1,500-2,000 in Mar 2025. Variable cost: Da Bac 2013 purchased inputs (seed 95.9 + fertiliser 399.6 + pesticide 73.4 USD/ha = 569 USD, ~11.9 M VND) inflated x1.25; Son La 2016 ~20 M incl. seed and fertiliser. Net before own labour ~13 M VND/ha, ~118,000 VND per labour day (below the 200,000 wage, consistent with low returns reported for NW uplands).

MAIZE_LOW.notes: Low-input / intercropped annual crops (maize with legumes, upland rice, peanut), manual weeding, partial clearance, no herbicide. Gross = ~2.8 t/ha maize x 6,200 + ~1.6 M legume intercrop. Low-input H'mong fields yield 1.5-3 t/ha (ICRAF); peanut HB 2.26 t/ha. Fewer purchased inputs, more weeding labour (thesis: all annual-crop managers used complete clearance at 5.3 mowings/yr; manual partial clearance raises labour). Net ~13 M VND/ha but ~93,000 VND per labour day (less labour-efficient than MAIZE_INT).

ORCHARD.notes: Longan / pomelo / other fruit with understorey slashing (thesis: perennial cropland intervention high in early years, then levels 2-3). Annualised over a 20-yr economic life at 8%. Mature gross 60 M VND/ha (e.g. 6 t/ha longan x 10,000 VND/kg) is deliberately between the rain-fed Mai Son longan trial (3.0 t/ha at yr 7, gross ~26 M) and commercial valley belts (Tan Lac red pomelo ~194 M; Cao Phong orange profit 600-1,000 M) that are not representative of remote Mai Chau/Da Bac slopes. Establishment 60 M (Mai Son sole longan ~2,480 USD/ha in 2012 inflated). Capital constraint is binding for most households.
sources: Land 2020, 9(11):451 fruit-tree agroforestry Mai Son 2012-2018 (verified)

ACACIA.notes: Short-rotation Acacia hybrid/mangium, weeding in early years, clearfell sold standing (buyer bears harvest). Stumpage 70 M VND/ha at 6 yr = ~95 m3 merchantable x ~740,000 VND/m3 (Thai Nguyen standing price Feb 2024; Luong Son company stands 99 m3 at 6 yr, 119 m3 at 7 yr; smallholder Da Bac 2013 revenue 50 M at 7 yr). Establishment 16 M = Da Bac 2007-13 Y1 cost 10.62 M inflated x1.5 (seedlings, fertiliser, partly hired labour). Returns ~141,000 VND per labour day before support. Thesis reports acacia the most recommended species (22 reports).
sources: Do Anh Tuan 2013, Tap chi KHLN 4/2013, optimal rotation Acacia hybrid Luong Son (Hoa Binh) https://vjfs.vafs.gov.vn/js/article/view/429 (verified)

cycle_values.composition: 50% bamboo (luong Dendrocalamus) + 50% Chukrasia tabularis / Meliaceae / native broadleaves

NATIVE_MIX.notes: Long rotation, low intensity. Bamboo: first harvest yr 5, culms >=3 yr, 30-40% per harvest (VAFS); traditional net 7-9 M VND/ha/yr, gross ~12 M full stand (Thanh Hoa luong). Native timber: ~120 m3/ha merchantable at 25 yr x ~4 M VND/m3 standing = ~480 M full stand; 200 M at 50% share (conservative vs Kyaw et al. 2024 Chukrasia 36,691 USD/ha, which assumes 1,440 surviving trees). At 8% the 25-yr timber pulse contributes only ~2.7 M/yr; bamboo carries early cash flow. ~104,000 VND per labour day before support. Thesis: Chukrasia 13 and bamboo 11 recommendation reports; Chukrasia >20 yr, luong 6-7 yr harvest cycle locally.
sources: Kyaw, Kainyande & Van Hiep 2024, Forestist 74(3):308-315, Chukrasia profitability Yen Chau https://forestist.org/index.php/pub/article/view/2596 (verified)

REGEN.notes: Natural regeneration zoning (khoanh nuoi xuc tien tai sinh), no planting. Market value = NTFP only (bamboo shoots, firewood, medicinal herbs, e.g. thesis herbal-medicine use in Tien Phong/Cao Son). No timber: natural-forest logging is closed and a regrown stand becomes 'production forest being natural forest'. Zoning period 6 yr under Decree 58/2024; dossier cost (50,000-150,000 VND/ha) is paid by the state. Support/payments in scenarios.json.
sources: Decree 58/2024/ND-CP Arts. 6, 10, 12, 13 (verified)
Luong 2025 thesis Fig. 4.4 herbal medicine (verified, qualitative)

PROTECT_STRICT.notes: Patrol, no cutting, PFES-compliant. Only non-destructive NTFP collection permitted by community rules (thesis: planting only in small pre-existing gaps, no logging in protection forest). Labour = patrol effort: thesis patrol teams of 5-7 members, mowing 0-1 times/yr, up to 4 for patrol access; ~1 person-day/ha/yr for a 300-400 ha community forest. Payments (PFES, protection contracts, carbon) in scenarios.json.
sources: Luong 2025 thesis, 'Knowledge about Local Ecological Policy' and 'Management practices' (verified, qualitative)

PROTECT_USE.notes: Informal extractive use: understorey cutting, firewood, bamboo shoots, NTFP, grazing. Output is imputed subsistence + cash value (assumption). In scenarios.json this activity receives 50% of the PROTECT_STRICT payment (expected loss from annual acceptance testing / penalties, assumption). Thesis: 7.5% of managers worried about cattle damage and bamboo-shoot theft; 25% of plots used inconsistently with official planning.
sources: Luong 2025 thesis (verified, qualitative)

FALLOW.notes: Fallow / natural regrowth on legal farmland (HNK/CLN/BHK/LUC), no management, no market output. Not eligible for forest support unless re-planned into forest land.
sources: definitional

summary_net_before_own_labour_vnd_per_ha._note: output - variable cost - annualised establishment; excludes payments and own-labour cost
